styleText: A rain-soaked neon noir city of stacked towers, syndicates and implants. Synthwave noir: muted trumpet and smoky saxophone over analog synth pads, slow brushed jazz drums, upright bass, tape hiss and rain on glass; late-night jazz in a Blade Runner city.

rows.prompt: Instrumental background music for a tabletop role-playing session. World and musical style: A rain-soaked neon noir city of stacked towers, syndicates and implants. Synthwave noir: muted trumpet and smoky saxophone over analog synth pads, slow brushed jazz drums, upright bass, tape hiss and rain on glass; late-night jazz in a Blade Runner city. Mood: a steady walking pace on an open road, light hopeful forward motion, the party on the move. Shaped to loop in the background: a steady texture from the first second, no long intro, no big final cadence, no fade-out, ending as it begins so it can repeat. Even dynamics; nothing sudden or jarring. No vocals, no lyrics, no singing. About 60 seconds long.
